description: CLIENT-WEIGHTED wealth-protection composite over the Atlas pillars. Pass your own weights (any of tax_efficiency, structure_strength, residence_clarity, crypto_clarity, succession_certainty, regulatory_transparency, institutional_stability) to score jurisdictions for a SPECIFIC client profile — there is no single public "best" ranking because the right weighting depends on the client. Omit weights for an illustrative default composite. Pass cc for one jurisdiction, or limit for the top N. Pure projection over Mirabello-verified data; illustrative comparative score, NOT advice.

cc.description: Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "PT", "AE", "KN") or its name in any of the 11 site languages ("Portugal", "Schweiz", "UAE"); input_notes shows how it was read.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Responses can be large; use this to keep the answer small.

weights.description: Optional weighting overrides for the index pillars, as an object of pillar name to weight; omit for the published default weights.

name: get_wealth_index

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Wealth Index
